reuse.why: The recurring-entry match goes into the existing isScheduleExcludedDay predicate, and the one site that had inlined its own weekend/holiday check (getDatesInRange) is switched to that predicate.

duplication.why: It removes the only inline copy of the excluded-day check and adds no new copies.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts; the server handler only calls it.

scope.why: Predicate, one call-site cleanup that the rule change needs, and two focused tests.

maintainability.why: Every holiday check now goes through one small predicate, so future holiday formats change in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; the diff removes the previous bypass in getDatesInRange
